notes: Modular three-product pricing (Outreach + Credits + bundles) with a price-increase-by-repackaging pattern: Growth widely listed $37/mo in 2024–25, now $47 monthly with $37.60 as the annual rate. 'Unlimited' = accounts and warmup; sending is hard-capped per plan. VIP managed tiers to $10K/mo listed in page FAQ.

change_events.description: Growth repositioned from ~$37/mo to $47 monthly ($37.60 annual), with new bundle SKUs (Starter/Scale/Agency) — effective increase via repackaging; date approximated, reported only.
change_events.user_reaction: Third-party pricing guides flagged the shift
